_doc: Published commercial micro-turbojets modelled 'as if they were our designs' (ROADMAP section 2, paper correlation). Each entry: the datasheet operating points (idle and max, sea-level ISA unless stated), the published dimensions and mass, and the design assumptions the suite needs to build the engine (thrust, OPR, rpm; T04 is not published and is left at the suite default, so EGT is a genuine prediction). Fuel densities: kerosene / Jet A-1 0.80 kg/l where the datasheet gives ml/min. Tolerances are the acceptance bands for `jet validate paper`.

engines.name: JetCat P300-PRO
engines.source: jetcat.de P300-PRO product page, technical data table (accessed 2026-09-16): idle 35,000 rpm / 14 N / 179 ml/min; max 105,000 rpm / 300 N / 980 ml/min; EGT 480-750 C; mass flow 0.5 kg/s; PR 3.55 (fleet database); 2730 g; D 132 mm; L 380.5 mm; SFC 0.157 kg/Nh

published.mass_note: engine incl. integrated pump/valves/ECU hood; suite mass is the bare engine

engines.notes: EGT quoted as a 480-750 C operating band; the max point uses 750 C (1023 K) with a 60 K tolerance.

engines.name: AMT Netherlands Olympus HP (E-start)
engines.source: AMT Netherlands 'Olympus HP gas-turbine' datasheet, June 2009 (jettech.ch mirror, page 1): 230 N @ 108,500 rpm; 13 N @ 36,000 rpm idle; PR 3.8; mass flow 450 g/s; normal EGT 700 C, max 750 C; 640 g/min at max; D 131 mm; L 384 mm; 2850 g
engines.notes: Idle fuel flow not published. Normal EGT 700 C used for the max point.

engines.name: JetCat P400-PRO-LN
engines.source: jetcat.de P400-PRO-LN product page, technical data table (accessed 2026-09-16): idle 30,000 rpm / 14 N / 200 ml/min; max 98,000 rpm / 425 N / 1392 ml/min; EGT 480-750 C; mass flow 0.67 kg/s; PR 3.8; 4010 g; D 148.4 mm; L 390 mm; SFC 0.157 kg/Nh

tolerance_doc: relative unless the quantity is EGT_K (absolute K). Length and mass carry wide bands because the datasheets include starter/hood/pump/ECU that the suite's bare-engine geometry does not.
